build_BaseMamba_model: build a BaseMamba model from BaseMambaArgs config and call init_weights to initialize all layer parameters
create_SSM_module: create an SSM module with configurable heads, state dimensions, conv size, and chunk size for selective state space modeling
create_MambaBlock_layer: create a MambaBlock layer combining RMSNorm and SSM with residual connection for a single transformer block
review_SSM_forward: review the SSM forward pass supporting both training via mamba_chunk_scan_combined and generation via selective_state_update
refactor_SSM_reset_parameters: refactor the SSM reset_parameters method to customize trunc_normal init for in_proj, out_proj, conv_weight, and A_log
